svg.title: The whole serial session
svg.desc: Every byte the host and the chip exchanged in the tour, each command decoded and checked against a model of the protocol. Recorded from an RTL simulation, not computed in the browser. Made by docs/tools/motion.py from docs/site/data/traces/overview.json.
